name: Anne K. Wasserburger
prior_offices: Niobrara County attorney (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Anne K. Wasserburger is the Niobrara County attorney and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official attorney page lists her in that office, and the official general election summary lists her with 758 votes.
